purpose: Neutral-workload, no-gate baseline of the real Nirnay production components at the P1.5 final head; no performance gate or resource maximum
source_sha_scope: commit containing the benchmark source at measurement time; a file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that contains it, so the later artifact-only commit is not self-bound
digest_input_format: SHA-256 over UTF-8 newline-delimited lines of the form stage_id|repetition_index|process_index|observation_ns_integer; each line terminated by one LF; lines ordered by process index, then within-process repetition index, then observation order; stage_id is the stage name, the two indices are zero-based decimal integers and the observation is a decimal u128 nanosecond integer; histogram and quantiles are never inputs
quantile_method: lower-nearest-rank: sort pooled observations ascending; zero-based index = min(n-1, floor(fraction*n)); fractions p50=0.50, p90=0.90, p95=0.95, p99=0.99, p999=0.999; tail quantiles are provisional evidence, not a gate
historical_artifact_disposition: benchmark-stability-2026-11-28.json is historical evidence and is not silently repaired: its 25 raw_observations_sha256 values were computed over an ordered input that was not retained (only histograms survived), so they cannot be reproduced; this harness emits a new, separately declared representation instead of rewriting that file
no_gate: evidence only: no performance gate, threshold, resource maximum, latency/throughput certificate or pass/fail criterion is defined by these measurements
claim_boundary: Neutral-workload measurements of real production components. NOT a production latency/throughput certificate, NOT nanosecond/HFT timing, NOT horizontal-scale evidence. No resource maximum is set.

measurement_protocol.command_template: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<outside checkout> cargo bench --locked -p paper-runner --bench production_components -- --run --events=64 --warmup-events=16 --repetitions=8 --payload-bytes=64 --seed=<distinct> --process-index=<index> --start-load-average=<operator-observed> --out=<temp JSON>
measurement_protocol.start_load_average: captured from sysctl -n vm.loadavg immediately before each process
measurement_protocol.cold_warm_recovery: repetition zero is the cold pass, later repetitions are warm; replay_recovery is a separate recovery stage and is small-sample

provenance_binding.measurement_revision_vs_base: Measured at final head 1aa1529d814a64eb74262ca41d9d7b82caceffdc, which includes the P1.3 ledger-code changes from branch revision 9e1231d7e213be23498de11dfcb3419f7d0fc4e1 that the earlier corrected baseline explicitly declared NOT measured. No source revision later than 1aa1529d814a64eb74262ca41d9d7b82caceffdc was measured; this artifact-only commit adding the final-head evidence and verifier flag is not self-bound.

digest_input_formats.file_digests: SHA-256 over exact bytes of git show <production_source_revision>:<path> for benches/production_components.rs, scripts/verify_benchmark_evidence.py and Cargo.lock; tree digest is git rev-parse <production_source_revision>^{tree}
digest_input_formats.benchmark_binary_digest: SHA-256 of the executed benchmark binary recorded in every processes[].binary_digest_sha256; the binary itself is not packaged
digest_input_formats.workload_digest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 newline-delimited '<process_index>|<workload_digest_sha256>\n' lines ordered by numeric process index; recomputed from processes[]
digest_input_formats.raw_observation_digest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 newline-delimited '<stage_id>|<raw_observations_digest_sha256>\n' lines ordered by stage_id; each stage digest is recomputed from retained observations

measurement_revision_scope: production_source_revision in provenance_binding is the exact final head 1aa1529d814a64eb74262ca41d9d7b82caceffdc measured by all five processes (source_sha is git rev-parse HEAD at measurement time). base_sha and the harness's BASE_SHA constant remain the historical branch marker 360c80711f6a10174f60787f6f08c89df51aca85, unchanged; the earlier corrected baseline measured bd6d7bbdee89b2abde80b5a27453ab2b311b9c7e and is a separate historical artifact.

small_sample_stages.declaration: replay_recovery yields one observation per repetition; p90/p95/p99/p999 are provisional evidence, never a gate
